text:
jess: Hey team — planning a small canary+bench for the new fused-kernel path + paged attention. Need volunteers to run kbench and eyeball regressions. target model: llama-13b, workloads: seq=2048/4096, batch=1/4. Can we do both FlashAttention and non-Flash variants?

devin: I can run the runs tomorrow morning (PST). What infra do you want? 4xA100 or 8xA100? Also do you want nvprof traces?

jess: Start on 4xA100, then escalate to 8xA100 if we see variance. nvprof traces for one seq/BS combo each (2048x1 and 4096x1) should be enough. Please grab p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec.

samar: Quick note — ensure KV-cache warm vs cold are both captured. For paged attention we saw different perf if cache is fragmented. Add flags: `--kv-cache warm,cold`.

ryan: pinging @jess here re: PR that touches scheduler. I left comments on https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1410 :eyes: — the kernel selector may choose fused_v2 even for short seqs, we should guard that in rollout.

jess: Good catch. For canary we'll force the kernel selector with runtime flag `kernel_override=fused_v2|paged` so we compare apples-to-apples. Add a config like below for kbench runs:

```
{ "model": "llama-13b", "kernels": ["fused_v2","fused_v2_no_flash","paged"], "seqs": [2048,4096], "batches": [1,4], "kv_cache": ["cold","warm"], "runs": 5 }
```

devin: Nice. I'll run the full matrix but will prioritize: (2048,1,cold) + (4096,1,warm) first. Expected baseline tokens/sec ~850-1200 on 4xA100 for fused without flash? We should capture deltas.

samar: Also capture GPU util, SM efficiency, and peak mem. If possible dump `nvidia-smi dmon` and `nvprof --analysis-metrics`. Example commands: 

```
# smoke
runtest --model llama-13b --kernel fused_v2 --paged --seq 2048 --batch 1 --kv-cache cold --prof nvprof --out /tmp/kbench_2048_1_cold.json
# full matrix via kbench
kbench run --config /path/to/config.json --out-dir /runs/kernel-canary/1857654321
```

ci-bot: CI: docker-build/runtime:kernel-tests passed for branch feat/fused-kernel (build 6789) :white_check_mark:

ryan: For the canary rollout plan, I'd propose: 5% traffic -> 1h perf sanity (no >5% latency regressions, no >3% tokens/sec drop), 25% -> 4h, then 100% if green. If any p99 spikes >10% abort and rollback.

jess: Agreed. Devin, once you have kbench outputs, upload to /runs/kernel-canary/1857654321 and post the summary (p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, mem). Also include diff against baseline commit `main@f2d3` so we can see regression numbers.

devin: Will do. ETA ~tomorrow 10:00 PST for first smoke, full matrix by EOD. I'll tag @ryan and @samar in the run artifact PR.

samar: Small measurement reminder — use `--seq-padding=left` and ensure batch packing disabled for these runs (`--pack=false`) so results are deterministic.

jess: Thanks. Final checklist: (1) CI green (2) kbench matrix uploaded (3) nvprof & nvidia dmon logs attached (4) PR review ack from @ryan. If all good we'll start 5% canary later that afternoon.

ryan: I'll review the PR once the kbench artifacts arrive. If we see any weird regressions, let's meet async in this thread first, then schedule a quick huddle.

devin: Uploading artifacts to /runs/kernel-canary/1857654321 now (partial). Link: s3://rwinf-kbench/kernel-canary/1857654321/partial.tar.gz

jess: Great — when you post the final run summary, include a short blurb like `summary: fused_v2 w/flash = +8% tokens/sec vs baseline, p99 +3%` (or whatever). That helps the canary decision. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: NOTE: nightly-e2e triggered for canary branch feat/fused-kernel — results expected in ~30m. :gear:
